summary: Baidu filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return dated September 15, 2026 covering daily buybacks of its Hong Kong-listed Class A ordinary shares (stock codes 09888/89888). Between September 7 and 15, 2026, the company repurchased 3,870,750 shares, roughly 0.025% per day, at daily volume-weighted prices from HKD 89.2402 to HKD 92.383. Issued shares and treasury shares were unchanged at 2,209,541,178; the repurchased shares await cancellation. No board recommendation or advisor is named. Traders should monitor cancellation timing and ongoing buyback pace for float reduction and support.
